blind.description: An ornate classical porcelain urn or lidded vase featuring a flared gold pedestal base, an ovoid body, two decorative scrolled gold handles, and a stepped lid topped with a pointed finial. The urn body is painted with rich red enamel bands adorned with gold leaf patterns, sandwiching a central cream-colored band depicting a painted pastoral or botanical scene. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with no floating, melted, or broken parts, sitting firmly flat on its own base.
blind.from_above: Concentric red and gold decorated rings surrounding a central pointed gold finial, with two symmetrical gold loop handles extending outward to the sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1/3 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 1.8 to 2 feet tall) and roughly 1.2 feet wide across the handles.

notes: proportions slightly wider than catalog due to handle span
